concepts.name: 参数地形探测站
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a complete desktop interactive lesson interface concept, Chinese AI general education chapter 5 for middle-school students. It should look like an exquisite usable educational scientific instrument, not a marketing landing page, admin dashboard or game overworld. One landscape 16:9 screen, ideally 1920x1080, generous readable typography and a very polished tangible 2.5D visual direction. Top-left small NOVA 奇点 brand, thin top bar with “第五章 · 模型的学习” and title “参数地形探测站”. The lesson's central interaction is a live LOSS LANDSCAPE generated from a two-parameter linear model: horizontal axes are parameter w and parameter b; vertical height represents mean squared prediction error. Make this unmistakably a PARAMETER SPACE, not geographic land and not a pathfinding game.
Main center-right 65% of the screen: a large beautifully fabricated translucent white porcelain/acrylic quadratic bowl surface on a precision graphite measurement frame, oblique aerial view, thin cobalt contour lines, one narrow diagonal trough with a single smooth minimum, mathematically plausible convex shape, NO multiple hills or arbitrary rugged mountains. The upright blue-white probe represents current (w,b) and sits on the higher near part of the slope; a few thin dotted exploratory trajectories and a single short descending arrow connect parameter positions. Fine visible w and b axis rules at the base, subtle loss-height scale, allow ample negative space. No literal forest terrain, avatar, spaceship, robot face or childish treasure.
Left 25%: a physically believable glass specimen strip with tiny green seedling silhouettes and 6 sample rows, heading “教学样本”, then a readable live scatter chart of light exposure x versus growth y with a cobalt fitted line and amber vertical residual marks. Small exact formula “ŷ = w·x + b”. Clearly visually link changing the probe/parameters with the fitted line changing. Below chart “预测与实际”, brief helper label “调整参数，看看误差怎样变化”.
Bottom narrow instrument control rail: TWO large tactile horizontal controls labelled “参数 w” and “参数 b”, current readings exactly “0.70” and “1.20”. A small loss readout exactly “损失 1.17”, unit mean squared error. Controls “单步学习”, “自动学习”, “重置”, learning-rate control label “步长”, value “0.025”. A quiet “实验记录” drawer on far right, not a dense dashboard. Show stage “实验 3 / 找到调整方向”.
Design style: scientific editorial clarity, cool-white background, matte graphite #18232e, cobalt blue #265ded, very restrained sage specimen green and amber residuals. Realistic soft contact shadows, frosted glass, porcelain, engraved fine marks; precision and curiosity rather than intimidating laboratory clutter. Thin elegant sans/Chinese serif mix, actual lesson controls large enough for students. At least 70% of content area devoted to the manipulative landscape and directly linked learning views. No neon/cyberpunk, fake code, decorative equations, progress scores, badges, leaderboards, completion percentages, branded product logos, browser/device frame or exterior mockup framing. Render all stated Chinese labels legibly. Do not add more mathematical labels than specified. This is an educational design proposal with enough accurate spatial UI anatomy to guide later implementation.

concepts.name: 训练回放编辑台
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a complete, premium desktop interactive educational experiment screen for Chinese middle-school AI curriculum chapter 5. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This concept must be fundamentally different from a 3D loss terrain or a generic machine-learning dashboard. The student directly EDITS A TRAINING TIMELINE and forks a controlled experiment at one time step; all affected later predictions, errors and parameter updates will be recalculated. It is a scientific time editor, not watching a video and not editing a movie.
Small top-left brand “NOVA 奇点”, header “第五章 · 模型的学习”, main label “训练回放编辑台”. Use a refined large continuous worktable/canvas with luminous white-grey glass sheets over matte graphite, restrained amber-orange and cyan accents, cool neutral background. Tangible time-slice ribbons like thin transparent scientific specimen plates, precision clips and a very clean modern research-studio feel. No vintage steampunk, noir criminal scene, childish paper crafts, neon sci-fi or rows of dashboard cards.
CENTER: two BIG synchronized experiment sheets named “实验 A” and “实验 B”, visually aligned to the same starting point. Each contains a single scatter plot with actual data dots and a prediction line, plus small explicit w/b parameter readouts and vertical amber residual marks. A quiet common caption “同样样本 · 同样起点”. The two predicted lines should visibly differ because only step size has been changed. The central selected time plate has been pulled forward with a gently exploded display of exactly four stages “预测” → “误差” → “调整” → “再预测”; arrows are actual causal links. Under the four stages, a readable small comparison of the two loss trajectories; normal A descends, B shows an unstable contrasting trajectory, label “损失变化”, no invented numeric percentages or performance rankings.
BOTTOM 25%: a substantial editable timeline, twelve evenly readable parameter-state plates, a clear vertical playhead selected at “第 4 步”. Earlier plates in subtle grey, selected plate outlined amber, later recomputed B branch in cyan. Branch visually splits from the selected playhead, then runs parallel to the original A timeline. A practical command beside the playhead “从这里重做”. Left transport buttons “单步”, “回放”, “暂停”; right intervention toolbox with exactly “修改步长”, “核对标签”, “冻结参数”. Changing only one variable is central; readable short note “只改一个条件，再比较”.
LEFT narrow tray: six seedling teaching-sample cards, “样本与标签”; no full garden landscape, no people. RIGHT lower compact experiment note “我的解释” with a blank ruled area for the learner to record why the two futures diverged, not a fake completed score. Professional readable controls, semantic colour across original and branch, generous clear margins, architectural asymmetry and sophisticated details. The exact small formula may be “ŷ = w·x + b”; no other fake math. Do not put a huge marketing headline or illustration above the work surface. No screen/device frame. Show the actual proposed operational surface clearly.

concepts.name: 透明模型校准台
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: an inventive polished interactive scientific lesson UI, Chinese AI general education chapter 5 for middle-school students. One full landscape 16:9 desktop course screen, ideally 1920x1080. The main manipulative is a large readable TRANSPARENT LINEAR-MODEL CALIBRATION INSTRUMENT. It makes numerical operations visible with tangible modules: input x → multiply by parameter w → add parameter b → prediction → compare with target. This is a learning visualisation of software arithmetic, not a literal AI hardware claim and not a neural-network construction kit.
Visual direction DIFFERENT from the bright landscape and time-editor concepts: deep desaturated graphite/slate work-surface, subtle warm side lighting and cream-white ceramic operators, amber feedback accents, softly lit transparent glass data pieces; restrained, serene, precise, tactile high-end optics-lab / industrial-design prototype. Avoid neon cyberpunk, hologram effects, giant robot heads, brains, generic dashboards, human characters, navigation maps and forests. Do not show a full laboratory room; the functional apparatus dominates the screen.
Top small “NOVA 奇点”, “第五章 · 模型的学习”, title “透明模型校准台”. Center 70%: three clearly separated mechanical-looking but elegant arithmetic blocks on a straight rail, with glass windows displaying labels “输入 x”, “× w”, “+ b”, then “预测”. A transparent sample capsule enters from the left. Visible current example: input “4.0”, w “0.70”, b “1.20”, predicted “4.00”, target “5.10”. Exactly correct arithmetic 0.70*4+1.20=4.00. Large physical knurled knobs attached to w and b, their roles immediately understandable. Do not imply the knob knows the correct label. At the output a double ruler with one blue prediction pointer and one amber actual pointer, connected by a clearly visible amber gap labelled “差距 1.10”.
Below the rail six small aligned sample strips show why fitting one example can change the other predictions, plus an aggregate error area “整组误差”. A slender AMBER feedback path from the error area loops back to the two parameter knobs; cyan arrows run only left to right for prediction. Show two modes as real large controls: “训练” and “使用”. A small removable or sealable model cartridge labelled “保存这组参数”; visually demonstrate a transparent latch, making it clear parameters can be locked during use. Bottom strip controls “手动校准”, “单步学习”, “自动学习”, “新样本检验”. Right side a modest white glass scatter-plot pane shows data points, the current straight prediction line, and residuals; reference formula “ŷ = w·x + b”.
Student-readable Chinese labels and bold operations, strong hierarchy, excellent material shadows, subtle wood-free scientific craftsmanship, generous negative space, clear tactile controls. No arbitrary loss score, badges, percentages or fake code. Show one actual lesson state on a useful operational work surface; no marketing hero or monitor/device mockup framing. The image should make direct manipulation of model parameters feel compelling and explainable.
